# teams_app_setup_policy_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a AppSetupPolicy instance to a user via Grant-CsTeamsAppSetupPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_name` (String) Name of the TeamsAppSetupPolicy instance to assign to the user.
- `user` (String) User the policy is assigned to (object id or user principal name). Changing it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Assignment identifier (the user's object id or user principal name).
